import base64, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/teilo/tmp/wyat-cuda-20261005")
base=root/"benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-b1.json"
saved=json.loads(base.read_text())
paths=[base,base.with_suffix(".wall.json"),base.with_suffix(".log")]
if "source_archive" in saved:
    paths.append(Path(saved["source_archive"]["path"]))
files=[]
for path in paths:
    data=path.read_bytes()
    files.append({"path":str(path.relative_to(root)),"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"base64":base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")})
queries=[]
for command in (["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],["nvidia-smi","--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],["pgrep","-af","benchmarks.analysis.cuda.attention.run"]):
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5,check=False)
    queries.append({"command":command,"exit_code":result.returncode,"stdout":result.stdout,"stderr":result.stderr})
print(json.dumps({"files":files,"release_queries":queries,"summary":{key:saved.get(key) for key in ("completed","quality_passed","dispatch_passed","phase","error","case_ids","unknown_case_ids","math_drift","efficient_drift")}},sort_keys=True))
